sentences.en: His remuneration consists of a base salary plus commissions.
sentences.zh: 他的报酬包括基本工资和提成。

sentences.en: The professor who invented it has the right to reasonable remuneration from the university.
sentences.zh: 那位发明它的教授有权利从学校获得合理的报酬。

sentences.en: If they received any kind of remuneration, they could no longer call themselves volunteers.
sentences.zh: 如果他们收到了任何形式的报酬，他们就不再能自称是志愿者了。

senses.zh: 酬报,酬劳;偿还,赔偿 酬金;工资;赔偿金
